project.name: backend-internal-calls
project.description: Vertical slice: logs and serves calls captured by the reverse-mode mitmproxy (wildfly-proxy) sitting in front of WildFly - the frontend's own browser calls, a separate traffic source from backend-calls' supplier calls. Fully isolated from backend-calls; reuses the same JSON wire shape only so the existing frontend models/export logic work against it unmodified. Hexagonal internally (domain/application/adapter packages under com.fathy.alfred.backend.internalcalls).
